name: James Whitfield

Create budget vs actuals tracking with variance alerts

Budget vs actuals lives in Excel with version control chaos
No real-time cash visibility, only knows position on day 5 of each month
sample_prompts: I need a live financial dashboard showing our cash position, monthly burn rate, and runway — connect it to our bank and NetSuite
Build me an automated month-end close system with reconciliation checklists and a final P&L report sent to the board automatically
Create a budget tracker where department heads can see actual vs planned spend and get alerts when they exceed 10% over budget
